_excludeNote: BUILD OUTPUT MUST STAY EXCLUDED. include is ./**/* with allowJs, so
without these tsc type-checks its own minified bundles: 210 files in
ios/App/App/public/assets (the cap-synced web build), 210 more inside
a committed .xcarchive, 212 in dist/ and 39 in storybook-static/.
Minified single-line bundles are pathological for the checker — this
was pushing tsc past the build's 4 GB heap and aborting `npm run
build` outright (2026-08-07). It also slowed every pre-commit hook and
CI run. No app source lives in these trees; ios/ is Swift plus
generated assets. .claude holds full worktree copies of the repo.
